question: Should generic tool-progress intent become a public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/reply-payload` contract for producer plugins and channel plugins?
rationale: The fix needs a cross-plugin seam between Codex and Slack, but adding public Plugin SDK exports is a durable compatibility decision that code history and tests cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve the narrow generic contract
options.body: Keep the constant and predicate public, fix structured-block propagation, and lock the semantics with focused compatibility tests.

options.title: Redesign before merge
options.body: Pause this PR and define another supported cross-plugin progress-intent seam before exposing new public reply-payload API.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the constant and predicate public, fix structured-block propagation, and lock the semantics with focused compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows ownership of the Slack native-data pipeline and substantial Plugin SDK reply-payload work, making this the closest available API-direction owner.
